title: Level-tagged text
description: One line of gold/leveled_texts.jsonl: an original German text with the CEFR level it sits at and why. Used to test that the Generator writes at the level it was asked for.

sublevel.description: Set when the text was written for one half of a level.

reasoning.description: Why this level and not the one below or above: sentence length, clause types, tenses, vocabulary range.

features.description: Ids of the hardest grammar points the text uses.

licence.description: Gold texts are written for Weg; nothing is copied.
